pages.text: A FUNCTION line starts a function.$(br2)It sits at x=5, right below a NOOP line. A LABEL with the function name follows. PARAMETER and RESULT lines may come next, then the code block. It ends with $(1)END FUNCTION$().
A function can only call functions above it, or itself. Struct and function declarations are not allowed inside a function.
Craft a NOOP block and a stone block together.
$(1)NOOP$(br)FUNCTION greet$(br)  PARAMETER name STRING "World"$(br)  PARAMETER mark CHAR '!'$(br)  RESULT result STRING$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN result "Hello, " ⊕ name ⊕ mark ;$(br)END FUNCTION$()
